13:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: College Football
The SMU Mustangs (7-2, 5-2 ACC) host the No. 13 Wake Forest Demon Deacons (8-1, 5-1 ACC) at Gerald J. Ford Stadium in Dallas. Wake Forest aims for a seven-game win streak behind Gio Lopez, while SMU recently defeated Virginia Tech 51-28.

16:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The No. 8 Tennessee Volunteers (7-2) visit the Texas A&M Aggies (4-5) at Kyle Field. Tennessee enters this matchup after beating Kentucky 34-6, while Texas A&M seek to snap a two-game skid and fell 17-9 to South Carolina in Week 10.
